gui.guildmark.tale.note.title: The Marlow Note
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.note.time: %1$s's note was paid late, on %3$s's word.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.note.seale: %1$s's stall was sealed for the note.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.why.note.l: The times were lean for five days.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.why.note.b: %1$s bought %2$s Marks of goods at the stall.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.why.note.g: %1$s asked %2$s for more days, and stood surety.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.why.note.c: %1$s's word took 6 Marks off the note.
The note was met, and the lender was to come in the morning.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.why.note.d: The note fell due with %s Marks still owing.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.why.note.b: %s's word on the note was not kept.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.why.note.h: %s took up the note when its holder was gone.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.why.note.n: No one was left to hold the note.
talk.guildmark.choice.tale.note.grace: Give them a few days. I'll answer for it.
talk.guildmark.choice.tale.note.law: What does the Order's law say of lenders?
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.short_0: You haven't that many Marks. Keep them.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.short_1: Not with an empty purse. Another day.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.mended_1: Already done. The sum's been cut.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.where_0: Go and ask. It can do no harm.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.where_1: Try the house, or the square at midday.
say.guildmark.talk.detail.tale.note.stan: The note is met. %s comes in the morning.
say.guildmark.talk.detail.tale.note.seal: %1$s's stall is closed for %2$s market days.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.stand_2_0: It's paid, all of it. Now we wait.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.stand_2_1: Paid. One more night, and it's done.
say.guildmark.talk.detail.tale.note.stan: The note is met. %s is coming to the stall.
The note has fallen due. %s is coming to the stall.
gui.guildmark.tale.fence.title: Fence Between
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.fence.mend: %1$s and %2$s broke bread, and the lane is friends again.
The times were lean, and a small thing grew.
Nobody took it up, and the lane went quiet.
%1$s agreed to come to the well, on %2$s's word.
%1$s was stung when %2$s said it to their face.
Only %s would come to the well.
Neither would come to the well.
No bread came, and the two would only nod.
talk.guildmark.choice.tale.fence.well: At the well, at dusk. They'll be there.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.fence.bread_shor: Bread, then. Two loaves, for the well.
They'll sit for bread. Bring two loaves.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.fence.bread_both: That's both. Dusk, at the well.
That will do it. Thank you.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.fence.stand_2_0: They'll sit together if there's bread.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.fence.stand_3_1: Now it's for the evening to say.
say.guildmark.talk.detail.tale.fence.sta: %1$s and %2$s have not spoken for %3$s days.
%1$s and %2$s are to meet at the well at dusk.
say.guildmark.talk.detail.tale.fence.sid: %s: the rope was lent, not given.
%s: the bucket was lent, and never brought back.
%s: three eggs were taken from the nest.
%s: the firewood was taken from the stack.
%s: their hens got into the vegetable patch.
%s: their dog digs up the garden every night.
%s: the gate was left open, and the hens got out.
%s: the rope was given, not lent.
%s: the bucket was given, and no one asked for it back.
%s: the hen laid them on the wrong side of the fence.
%s: the stack was shared, and only a share was taken.
%s: the hens never touched the patch.
%s: the dog has never left the yard.
%s: the gate was shut, and someone else opened it.
